findings.source_excerpt: you may change playbooks if you desire
findings.problem: 劇本 ordinarily means scenario/script and obscures the permission to change the character's playbook.
findings.required_change: 依整合者既定術語改為『也可以更換扮演書』。

findings.source_excerpt: It is unknown from what company these mercenaries hail
findings.draft_excerpt: 目前不知這些傭兵隸屬哪家公司

findings.required_change: 改為『目前不知這些傭兵隸屬哪支傭兵團』。

findings.source_excerpt: forming an ominous advancing line with humming strange-shields and attendant swarms

findings.required_change: 將『隨侍蟲群』改為『隨侍的使魔群』或不指定昆蟲形態的『隨侍群體』。
